description: This lexicon is in a not officially released state. It is subject to change. | Record containing a teal.fm post. Teal.fm posts include a track that is connected to the post, and could have some text. Replies, by default, have the same track as the parent post.

text.description: The primary post content. May be an empty string, if there are embeds.

track.description: The track associated with this post.

facets.description: Rich text facets, which may include mentions, links, and other features.

langs.description: Indicates human language of post primary text content.

tags.description: Additional hashtags, in addition to any included in post text and facets.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this post was originally created.
